lifecycle: Default help; --selftest reads config and synthetic DataFrames only, no writes/native program/notification; --prepare explicit after root review only. --run requires same thread identity and no active solver. One owned BAT/child tree, no duplicate or overwritten label. Seal solver completion and all raw hashes before offline inspection. Completed-solver analysis failure must be repaired offline, never rerun. On live owned-wrapper failure, verify its command line before stopping only its tree.
completion: Exactly one new same-thread terminal codex queue attempt via exclusive queue_attempt record, no retry/rearm/connectivity selftest. Neither old worker nor old notifier is called. Completion message requires later physical/theory review, not automatic peak/full/formal admission.
